children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Pick a dashboard language, set the instance default, and translate Gameplane or module text.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Only languages at 80% translated appear in the picker. Missing messages show in English.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Pick the dashboard language on Theme & Appearance. Signed-in choices follow you across devices.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Saved to your account when signed in; Automatic clears it.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Signed-out pages save the choice to that browser only.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Dates, numbers and relative times follow the active language.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Set the instance default, then a language for each notification destination.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Instance default: Language card in Admin Settings, starts as English.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Notification language: Discord, email and webhook destinations.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Telemetry: the extended usage report includes the UI language.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Each language is a folder under i18n/locales with app.json and meta.json.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Choice: account → browser → instance default → English

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Listed in the picker at 80% translated

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Check packs with go run ./cmd/i18n-check locales

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
